problem: The subscript and superscript examples are written as plain 'H2O' and 'x2'. The whole point of the sentence is the effect of the tags, and a student can read 'x2' as x times 2.
fix: sub makes subscript, as in H<sub>2</sub>O. sup makes superscript, as in x<sup>2</sup>.

problem: 'colspan=2 makes one cell cover two columns to its right' is ambiguous. A student can read it as the cell's own column plus two more columns, giving three columns.
fix: colspan=2 makes one cell span two columns in total: its own column and the one cell to its right. rowspan=2 makes it span two rows in total: its own row and the row below.

problem: Saying alt is 'required' without the exception can confuse students who see alt="" in real pages.
fix: Add: the alt attribute must always be present. For a purely decorative image, give it an empty value, alt="", so screen readers skip it.

problem: The last row lists three cells, 'Sum', an empty cell, and '70'. The empty cell appears as its own box, so the figure does not visually show the colspan=2 merge that the caption and aria text describe.
fix: Show the last row as two cells only, with 'Sum' spanning the first two grid columns, or drop the empty-string cell so the merge is visible.

problem: The tags are written without angle brackets, so the text runs together (for example 'captionStationery bill/caption', 'tdPen'). A student cannot see where the tag name ends and the content begins.
fix: Use escaped brackets as elsewhere in the chapter, e.g. <caption>Stationery bill</caption>, <td>Pen</td>, <td colspan=2>Sum</td>.
